faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) under the School of Public Policy for the AdaptAIR project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post is Project Manager, with a total vacancy count of 1 position for the candidate.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Project Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 6 November 2026. Applicants must ensure their submissions reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in any field with at least 12 years of experience or a Masters Degree with at least 05 years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay ranging from Rs. 64,260 to Rs. 83,840 per month plus HRA @30% depending on the pay structure progression.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for this job opening?
faq.answer: Candidates need to download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website, fill it completely, and send it via email to Prof. Anshu Ogra with the advertisement number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of selection for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves short-listing of candidates based on their qualifications and experience requirements, followed by an online interview for short-listed applicants.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required in the official notification for submitting the application form for this project-based vacancy.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job location for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: The job location for the selected candidate will be New Delhi, specifically at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi campus in Hauz Khas.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual and project-based footing, with consolidated pay renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier.
